136.html:
136 aṅgulī́ya m.n. 'finger-ring' R. [aṅgúli-]
    Pk. aṁgulīya-, °aga-, °lijjaga- m.n., Mai. (LSI) aṅgulī; Gy. wel. vaṅlī f. 'earring' (orig. m. whence v- from m. article). — Also Pa. aṅguleyyaka- n., Pk. aṁgulēyaya- m.n.

9353.html:
9353 bhaṅgá¹ 'breaking' VS., m. 'a break' Mn., 'piece' Kālid. [√bhañj]
    Pa. bhaṅga- n. 'breaking up', sākhā-bhaṅga- 'layer of broken off branches'; Pk. bhaṁga- m. 'destruction, broken portion, piece' (Ap. adj. 'broken'); Gy. rum. phang- 'to break'; S. bhaṅgu m. 'obstacle', bhāṅo m. 'share' (ā?); WPah.bhal. bhaṅgṛi f. 'sheep with black or white spots on face'; N. bhaṅālo 'fork in a stream'; A. bhāṅiba tr. 'to break'; B. bhāṅā 'to be broken'; Or. bhaṅgā 'act of breaking', bhāṅgibā tr. and intr. 'to break'; Mth. bhā̃gaṭh 'breakage'; OG. bhāṁgaü m. 'piece', G. bhā̃gũ 'broken to pieces', bhā̃gvũ tr. and intr. 'to break'; M. bhā̃g m. 'parting in a woman's hair', bhā̃gā m. 'division of a field, field', bhā̃gṇẽ 'to divide', bhaṅgṇẽ 'to break, destroy'.
    *bhaṅgākara-.

13227.html:
13227 samuccaya m. 'aggregation' Kālid. [√ci¹]
    Pa. Pk. samuccaya- m. 'collection'; P. samuccā 'whole, entire', °ce 'on the whole, entirely'; H. samūcā 'all, entire, whole'. — Retention of -m- unexpl.; if ← Sk. or Pk., then the loan must be dated after change of -m- > -ṽ- and before simplification of double consonants.

8330.html:
8330 pūra¹ 'filling' BhP., m. 'flood' Suśr., pūraka- 'filling' MBh., m. 'flood' BhP. [√pr̥̄]
    Pa. pūra- 'full', pūraka- 'filling'; Pk. pūra- m. 'flood', pūraya- 'filling'; Gy. arm. por 'full'; Wg. purṓ 'finished'; Paš.lauṛ. dar. purā́ 'full, passed'; Shum. pura 'full', Gaw. pūr, Kal.rumb. pūri; Sh. pūrṷ 'complete, correct, all'; K. pūrᵘ 'full, complete', pog. pūra 'fully'; S. pūru m. 'load of people in a ferry, the filling of a pit', pūro 'full'; L. pūrā 'full'; P. pūr m. 'fullness, boatload', pūrā 'full'; Ku. pūr, puro 'full, perfect'; N. puro 'complete', purāpur 'fully'; A. pūr, pūrā 'full'; B. pū̆r 'flow, stream', pūra, purā, porā 'full'; Or. purā 'full', sb. 'filling of a sandwich'; H. pūrā 'full', OMarw. puraü; G. pū̆r n. 'flood', pūrũ 'full', M. purā, Ko. pūrā; Si. pura 'fortnight of the waxing moon', purā 'full'.
    *pūriṣṭha-; saṁpūraka-; *gandhapūrikā-, *madhyapūra-.
    Addenda: pūra-¹: S.kcch. pūro keṇū 'to finish'; WPah.kṭg. (kc.) purɔ 'full, complete'.
